title: 6 Things a Godly Man Does in the Last 30 Minutes of His Workday
caption:
The last thing you do at work is the thing you'll actually remember doing.

A godly man doesn't coast the last half hour. He finishes what he's been avoiding, closes the loop he opened that morning, and checks his own work like Someone else will grade it. Because Someone will.

Then he prays before he walks in the door, so the guy from the office isn't the guy who shows up at home.

#faith #work #christianmen #discipline #manofgod
